race.comment: HEAD OF THE RIVER (8) raced below her best last time when ninth over 1200m at Eagle Farm, beaten 8 lengths. This doesn't look as hard so she is likely to play a big role. CONQUER DAT (1) was in the firing line on the turn and finished third last time over 1000m at this track, beaten 1.75 lengths. Hard to beat in this suitable race. DRACARIAN (2) started favourite last time out over 1200m at Nanango but found a couple better, making it three minor placings from four starts this campaign. Drawn to enjoy a good run so he is well placed to play a role. ROTHIRA (9) is facing the starter for the first time but has shown ability at the trials and won't need to be a superstar to be competitive against this lot. Keep very safe.
